collections.name: The Edit
collections.description: What the desk is pointing at this issue — shop the look.

products.title: The Everyday Scarf
products.description: A generous square of heavyweight silk twill, hand-rolled at the edge, in a single quiet colour. The one accessory the wardrobe story kept coming back to — it finishes a coat and asks for nothing.
products.seoTitle: The Everyday Scarf — hand-rolled silk twill | Mode & Object
products.seoDescription: A heavyweight silk twill scarf in a single quiet colour, hand-rolled at the edge.

products.title: The Studio Carafe
products.description: A hand-thrown stoneware carafe from the atelier we visited this issue — matte, off-white, a little uneven on purpose. Made in small runs, so no two are quite the same. Water, wine, or a single stem.
products.seoTitle: The Studio Carafe — hand-thrown stoneware | Mode & Object
products.seoDescription: A hand-thrown matte stoneware carafe, made in small runs — no two the same.

products.title: The Acetate Sunglasses
products.description: A rounded acetate frame in a warm tortoise, cut from a single sheet and polished by hand. The shape the beauty desk keeps recommending because it flatters almost everyone and dates almost never.
products.seoTitle: The Acetate Sunglasses — hand-polished frame | Mode & Object
products.seoDescription: A rounded acetate sunglass frame in warm tortoise, cut and polished by hand.

products.title: Studio Print No. 4
products.description: An archival giclée print from our contributing photographer Iris Blum — a still life from the design portfolio, editioned and signed. Ships flat, unframed, in a run of one hundred.
products.seoTitle: Studio Print No. 4 — signed archival giclée | Mode & Object
products.seoDescription: A signed, editioned archival giclée still life by Iris Blum, in a run of one hundred.
